tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// nā ro gsang spyod kyi dmigs rim bzhugs so//

༄༅// "$ dpal nā ro pa la phyag 'tshal lo// 'dir gsang spyod zlog sgom gyi gdams pa zab mo 'di nyid 'chad par byed pa la| gnas gang du 'gro ba/ dus nam 'gro ba/ gang zag gang gis 'gro ba/ spyod lam ji lta bus 'gro ba dang rnam pa bzhi'i nang nas/ dang po gnas gang du 'gro ba de ston par byed de/ de yang ro snyoms gzhung du/ ri bo dang ni bzhi mdo dang*// shing gcig chu 'gram thang chen dang*// de bzhin dben pa bas mtha' dang*// ri bo'i sul dang rtse mo dang*// pad+ma'i tshal ni yid 'ong dang*// rdzing bu chu ngogs yul rnams dang*// tshang tshing phug dang rgya mtsho'i 'gram// gdod nas dag pa'i dur khrod che// mtshan mo ma mo'i khyim rnams su// sngags pas der bsgom shis par mdzad// ces pa'i gnas de rnams su 'gro bar byed pa yin no// gzhan yang mi mang po phung ba'i shul dang*/ g.yul ngo chen po sprad pa'i sa dang*/ 'jig rten gyi lha 'dre gdug pa can gnas pa'i sa dang*/ mdor na skye bo phal pa rnams kyis nyin mo'ang 'gro mi nus shing 'jigs shing ya nga ba'i gnas rnams su 'gro ba yin no// gnyis pa dus nam 'gro ba ni/ saṃ bhu ṭi las/ rdo rje nyi ma nub pa dang*// de 'og sgrub pa brtsam par bya| /zhes dang*/ ro snyoms gzhung du/ mtshan dus gsang ste rgyu bar bya// zhes gsungs pa ltar/ dgongs mo nyi ma nub nas/ mi la sogs pa gzhan gyis ma tshor bar gsang spyod kyi gnas der 'gro /sang snga dro gzhan gyis ma tshor bar rang gi gnas su log yong bar byed/ mi med lung stong la sogs pa yin na tshar lhongs ma 'grig bar de khar sdod pa'o// gsum pa gang zag gang gis 'gro ba ni/ ro snyoms gzhung du/ cung zad drod ni thob pa dang*// de nas spyod pa brtsam par bya// zhes gsungs pa ltar/ kun tu bzang po'i spyod pa mthar phyin pa| mdor na snang ba sems su shes shing*/ phyi rol du lha 'drer 'dzin pa dag pa'i gang zag gcig gis 'gro ba yin no// bzhi pa spyod lam ji lta bus 'gro ba la/

sngon du 'gro ba rten 'brel phun sum tshogs pa'i khyad par/ dngos gzhi stong nyid kyi zlog sgom gyis bdag 'dzin rtsad gcod pa/ rjes snying rje'i zlog sgom gyis lha 'dre gdul byarasdud pa dang rnam pa gsum yod pa las| dang po sngon du 'gro ba rten 'brel phun sum tshogs pa'i khyad par de ston par byed de/ de la gos su ci bgo ba/ rgyan du ci btags pa/ zas su ci za ba/ grogs su gang bkri ba/ byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa/ bla ma la lus phul te gsol ba btab pa/ yi dam lha la dbang bskur zhu ba dang rnam pa bdun yod pa las/ dang po gos su ci ba go ba ni/ ro snyoms gzhung du/ ro yi gos ni ba go bya zhing*// ro yi thal ba'ang bgo bar bya// 'dzin pa med pa'i sems kyis su// kha dog bcos ma'i ras rnying bgo zhes gsungs pa ltar/ ro'i gos gyon pa dang*/ ro bsregs pa'i thal ba lus la byug pa dang*/ kha dog bcos ma'i ras nag po dang*/ rnying pa la sogs pa dang*/ mdor na gzhan gyis phrogs kyang chags pa mi skye ba'i gos hrul po sogs gyon pa'o// gnyis pa rgyan du ci btags pa ni/ gzhung du/ gu dza na la sogs pa yi// 'bras bu'i 'phreng sogs kyis brgyan bya// zhes gsungs pa ltar/ shing gu dza na la sogs pa'i 'bras bu'i 'phreng bas rgyan byed pa ste/ mdor na shing gi 'bras bu'i rgyan byed pa'o// 'dir shing gi 'bras bu'i rgyan byed pa ni/ rus rgyan gyi dod po ste/ dgos pa dpa' bo mkha' 'gro dang skal ba mnyam pa'o/ gsum pa zas su ci za ba ni// gzhung du/ bza' ba mi 'chi bcu phyed do// zhes gsungs pa ltar/ zas su sha lnga dang*| skom du bdud rtsi lnga sten par byed do// de'i dgos pa ni mi 'chi ba ste/ 'chi med tshe'i rig 'dzin brnyes pa'o// sha lnga dang bdud rtsi lnga ma 'byor na las su thug phrad gang byung tshad za ba'o| /bzhi pa grogs su gang bkri ba ni/ gzhung du/

shin tu bzhin bzangs mig yangs ma// rang gi dbang bskur snying rjer ldan// rdo rje bu mo 'di khyer nas// brtul zhugs can gyis spyod pa bya// zhes gsungs pa ltar/ chags lam pa yin na/ las rgya dang 'grogs nas 'gro/ grol lam pa yin na stong nyid kyi nyams bzang po dang 'grogs nas 'gro bar byed do// lnga pa byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa ni/ gzhung du/ sems can rjes su bzung bya'i phyir/ blo dang ldan pas rgyu bar bya/ zhes gsungs pa ltar/ sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob par bya/ de'i ched du gsang spyod zlog sgom gyi gdams pa zab mo 'di nyid nyams su blang bar bya'o snyam du sems bskyed par bya'o// drug pa bla ma la lus phul te gsol ba btab pa ni/ gzhung du/ 'jam pa'i rdo rjes bdag dbang bskur// zhes gsungs pa ltar/ rang gi spyi bor drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma/ de'i dbu thog nas yar gsang spyod brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams mtho brtsegs kyis bzhugs par bsam/ de dag la rang gi lus longs spyod dang bcas pa thams cad dang*/ khyad par du rang gi lus 'di nyid ltos med du phul te// bdag gis gsang ba'i spyod pa spyad par bya'o snyam pa'i sgo nas ngag tu/ spy-i gtsug nyi zla'i gdan steng du// zhes sogs gsang spyod brgyud rim gyi gsol 'debs kha tsam tshig tsam ma yin par snying khong rus pa'i gting nas phar thim 'gro ba lta bu/ tshur 'bral mi phod pa lta bu/ phur tshugs su legs par btab pas/ bla ma gong ma gong ma rnams 'od du zhu nas rtsa ba'i bla ma la thim// bdun pa yi dam lha la dbang bskur zhub ni/ skad cig gis rtsa ba'i bla ma de nyid dpal 'khor lo sdom pa yab yum du gsal ba'i sbyor mtshams nas byang sems kyi bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs rang gi spyi bo gang*/ bum pa'i dbang thob/ lus kyi sgo nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib ma lus pa dag /lam bskyed pa'i rim pa bsgom pa la dbang*/

'bras bu sprul ba'i sku thob pa'i rten 'brel mngon sum du sgrig mgrin pa yan chad gang*/ gsang ba'i dbang thob/ ngag gi sgo nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib ma lus pa dag lam rtsa rlung thig le bsgom pa la dbang*| 'bras bu longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku thob pa'i rten 'brel mngon sum du sgrig snying ga yan chad gang*/ shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/ yid kyi sgo nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib bag chags dang bcas pa ma lus pa dag pho nya'i lam bsgom pa la dbang 'bras bu chos kyi sku thob pa'i rten 'brel mngon sum du sgrig mthar lus thams cad gang*/ bzhi pa tshig dbang rin po che thob/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi sgo nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib bag chags dang bcas pa ma lus pa dag lam phyag rgya chen po bsgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu ngo bo nyid kyi sku thob pa'i rten 'brel mngon sum du sgrig mthar bla ma 'od du zhu rang la thim/ bla ma'i sku gsung thugs dang rang gi lus ngag yid gsum dbyer med du 'dres pa la mnyam par bzhag des sngon du 'gro ba rten 'brel phun sum tshogs pa'i khyad par de song nas// gnyis pa dngos gzhi stong nyid kyi zlog sgom gyis bdag 'dzin rtsad nas gcad pa de ston par byed de/ de la spros bcas spros med| shin tu spros med kyi spyod pa dang gsum yod pa las/ dang po spros bcas ni/ gzhung du/ ba spu rnams kyi bu ga nas// phyogs bcu rnams su spro bar bya// zhes gsungs pa ltar/ rang nyid rdo rje phag mo sku mdog dmar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis/ phyag g.yas gri gug nam mkha' la 'phyar ba/ g.yon thod khrag thugs kar 'dzin pa| thod pa skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ rlon pa khrag 'dzag pa lnga bcu'i do shal byas pa/ zhabs g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang ba'i gar stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ sku stod kyis gzugs khams yan chad khyab pa/ sku smad kyis 'dod pa'i khams thams cad khyab pa/ de'i ba spu'i bu ga thams cad nas khro bo'i sku'i tshogs dpag tu med pa me stag gi skye tshul du 'phro ba shin tu nas kyang 'jigs su rung ba gcig gsal btab/

gsang spyod kyi gnas der gnas pa'i lha 'dre thams cad 'jigs shing*/ sdug bsngal gyi skad ngan sna tshogs 'don cing phyogs bcur 'bros par brtsams pa na/ ye shes kyi me dang rdo rje'i ra ba rnams kyis bskor nas/ de dag gis 'bros mi thub par rang nyid kyi mdun du lha 'dre de dag til 'bru'am/ yungs 'bru tsam du gnas shing*| 'dar phril li li yod par bsam/ 'gro ba'i dus su lus kyi gar stabs dang*/ ngag tu hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭaḥphaṭaḥkyi sgra dang bcas pas gsang spyod kyi gnas der 'gro bar byed/ der sleb pa dang spros bcas kyi spros pa thang ma chad kyi bar du byed do// gnyis pa spros med kyi spyod pa ni/ lta ba bden 'dzin dang bral ba/ sgom pa yid la mi byed pa/ spyod pa ro snyoms nus pa| 'bras bu re dogs kyi g.yang sa chod pa'o// de yang gzhung du/ shin tu mnyam gzhag rab bsgoms nas// dngos grub myur du thob par 'gyur// zhes gsungs pa ltar/ lta ba bden 'dzin dang bral ba ni/ phyi nang gi dngos po thams cad la bden 'dzin zhig pa ste/ snang ba sems su shes pa'o// sgom pa yid la mi byed pa ni/ dus gsum gyi spros pa thams cad sems ma bcos par rang babs su 'jog pa'o// spyod pa ro snyoms nus pa ni/ bzang rtog ngan rtog ci byung yang ma spangs par de kha'i ngang la mnyam par 'jog pa'o// 'bras bu re dogs kyi g.yang sa chod pa ni/ yar sangs rgyas thob tu re ba mi byed/ mar ngan song du lhungs kyi dogs pa mi byed par sems ma bcos par mnyam par 'jog pa'o// gsum pa shin tu spros med kyi spyod pa ni/ de nas gnyid chog la khad byung ba dang*/ rang nyid tha mal du gnas pa'i spyi bo nas yar rang gi sems rdo rje rnal 'byor ma tshon gang ba gcig rgyang ste thon par bsam ste/ ngag tu phaṭaḥces brjod/ yang phaṭaḥces brjod pas rdo rje rnal 'byor ma de je che je che la song bar bsam/

rang gi mdun du thod pa'i sgyed bu rang byung du byung bar bsam| yang phaṭaḥces brjod pas/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i gri gug gis rang gi thod pa bcad nas sgyed bu'i steng du gzhag de yang phyi dkar la nang dmar ba stong gsum gyi stong chen po 'jig rten gyi khams dang mnyam par bsam/ yang phaṭaḥces brjod pas/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i gri gug gis rang gi lus de rtsen blangs nas thod pa'i nang du spungs te rub kyis gtubs te/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes pas bdud rtsir byin gyis brlabs nas/ yang phaṭaḥces brjod pas/ bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs dang bcas pa thams cad dang*/ yang phaṭaḥces brjod pas/ dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs dang bcas pa thams cad dang*/ yang phaṭaḥces brjod pas/ gzhi bdag des gtsos pa'i lha 'dre thams cad dang*/ bgegs rigs stong phrag brgyad cu/ gdon rigs sum brgya drug cu la sogs pa mdor na gnod byed kyi rigs su gyur pa thams cad dang*/ yang phaṭaḥces brjod pas/ 'gro ba rigs drug gi sems can thams cad skad cig gis mdun du yi dam gyi rnam par khra phung gis byon par bsam zhing*/ de dag gis bdud rtsi gsol bas tshim zhing mnyes par bsam mo// yang phaṭa ces brjod pas| mchod pa'i yul de dag dang*/ mchod pa'i rdzas dang*/ mchod pa po mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid kyi ngang la mnyam par gzhag go /de nas dam bca' bzhi po 'di dag bya ste/ steng nas thog byung ngam/ 'og nas mtsho rdol lam/ g.yas nas ri nyil lam/ g.yon nas brag ral lam/ ci byung yang da gnas 'dir gsang spyod mthar ma phyin gyi bar la lus 'gul bskyod byed re zhes yid kyi dam bca' drag po byed pa'o// de ltar byas pas lha 'dre rnams la gos kyi thu ba rdos mnan pa bzhin song nas tshar lhongs myur du 'grig pa'o// yang dkar 'gyed ni| phaṭaḥces brjod pas/ rang gi sems rdo rje rnal 'byor ma tshon gang ba gcig spyi bo tshangs pa'i bu ga nas yar rgyangs te thon par bsam zhing*/

yang je che je che la song bar bsam| yang*/ phaṭaḥces brjod pas rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i gri gug gis rang gi thod pa bcad nas mdun du gzhag cing*/ thod pa de nyid rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba stong gsum gyi 'jig rten gyi khams dang mnyam par bsam mo// de nas rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i gri gug gis rang gi lus de nyid rtse na blangs te/ rin po che'i snod kyi nang du 'o mar byin gyis brlabs nas gnod byed kyis gtso byas pa'i snang srid kyi lha 'dre thams cad la byin pas/ lha 'dre de dag gis 'thungs shing khrus byas pas/ lus kyi na tsha sems kyi sdug bsngal thams cad dag nas/ lus sems bde bas tshim par bsam mo// dmar 'gyed ni/ gzhan gong dang 'dra ba las/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i gri gug gis rang gi thod pa bcad nas mdun du rang byung gi sgyed bu'i steng du gzhag cing*/ de yang stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams dang mnyam pa gcig bsam mo// de nas yang phaṭaḥces brjod pas rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i gri gug gis rang gi lus de nyid rtsen blangs te/ thod pa'i nang du spungs te gtubs nas khrag tu dmar nyog ste song bar bsam/ de nas dkar la mi dga' zhing*/ dmar la dga' ba'i gnod byed kyi lha 'dres gtsos pa'i snang srid kyi lha 'dre thams cad la sbyin pas/ lha 'dre de dag gis 'thungs shing ngoms par byas pas/ lus kyi na tsha sems kyi sdug bsngal la sogs pa thams cad zhi nas/ lus sems bde bas tshim par bsam mo// de nas yang phaṭaḥces brjod pas/ gnod byed kyi lha 'dres gtsos pa'i lha 'dre de dag dang*/ thod pa'i nang gi rdzas dang*/ rang nyid kyi rnam par shes pa gsum ga mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid kyi ngang la mnyam par gzhag go /sprang ston ni/ yang phaṭaḥces brjod pas/ rang gi sems rdo rje rnal 'byor ma tshon gang pa gcig spyi bo tshangs pa'i bug nas yar rgyangs te thon zhing je che je che la song bar bsam/

yang phaṭaḥces brjod pas rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i gri gug gis rang gi lus gshags nas| pags pas 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad khyab par byas nas/ de'i khud du sha dang rus pa rnams gtubs te/ khrag dang sbags te che thob chung thob mnyam pa ris med du gnod byed kyi lha 'dres gtsos pa'i snang srid kyi lha 'dre thams cad la sbyin pas/ lha 'dre de dag thams cad ngoms shing dga' bar byas pas/ lus kyi na tsha sems kyi sdug bsngal la sogs pa thams cad zhi nas/ lus sems bde bas tshim par bsam mo// de nas yang phaṭaḥces brjod pas/ gnod byed kyis gtsos pa'i lha 'dre de dag dang*/ thod pa'i nang gi rdzas dang*/ rang nyid kyi rnam par shes pa'i ngo bo rdo rje rnal 'byor ma gsum ga mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid kyi ngang la mnyam par gzhag go /yang spus 'dod du gtong na phaṭaḥces brjod pas| rang gi rnam par shes pa'i ngo bo rdo rje rnal 'byor ma tshon gang pa gcig spyi bo tshangs pa'i bu ga nas rgyangs te thon zhing je che je che la song bar bsam/ yang phaṭaḥces brjod pas snang srid kyi lha 'dre thams cad skad cig la 'dus par bsam/ yang phaṭaḥces brjod pas rnal 'byor ma'i gri gug gis rang gi mgo bo bcad nas lhan cig skyes pa'i 'dre la sbyin/ snying gnod byed kyi 'dre la sbyin/ de nas don snying lnga 'dod pa la don snying lnga sbyin/ dbang po lnga 'dod pa la dbang po lnga sbyin/ pags pa 'dod pa la pags pa sbyin/ khrag 'dod pa la khrag sbyin/ sha 'dod pa la sha sbyin/ tshil 'dod pa la tshil sbyin/ rus pa 'dod pa la rus pa sbyin/ yan lag 'dod pa la yan lag sbyin/ de nas yang phaṭaḥces brjod pas/ gnod byed kyi lha 'dre des gtso byas pa'i lha 'dre de dag dang*/ rang gi lus dang*/ rnam par shes pa'i ngo bo rdo rje rnal 'byor ma gsum ga mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid kyi ngang la mnyam par bzhag go /de las 'phros pa srid pa gsum gyi ngo sprod bya ba la/

steng lha'i srid pa ni/ rang nyid lha yul sum cu rtsa gsum na lha'i dbang po brgya byin du gyur nas/ de la lha'i bu dang bu mo la sogs pa lha dbang sum cu rtsa gsum gyis g.yas nas mchod pa dpag tu med pa phul ba de la dga' ba skye'am mi skye lta/ dga' ba skye 'dug na de la skye rgyu ci yod rang gi sems kyis byas ba ma gtogs don la grub pa med pa sems kyis thag bcad/ yang de dag skad cig gis bdud dang srin por gyur nas rang nyid la mi snyan pa sna tshogs brjod cing rdeg btsog sna tshogs byas par bsam la/ mi dga' ba'i blo skye'am mi skye lta/ skye na de la mi dga' ba'i blo skye rgyu ci yod/ rang gi sems kyis byas pa ma gtogs don la grub pa med pa sems kyis thag bcad/ bar mi'i srid pa ni/ yang rang nyid mi yul du mi'i rgyal po stong 'khor los sgyur pa'i rgyal por gyur nas/ de la g.yas nas mi'i bu dang bu mo sna tshogs pas rnyed pa dang bkur sti dpag tu med pa phul bar bsams la/ de la dga' ba skye'am mi skye lta/ dga' ba skye 'dug na de la dga' ba skye rgyu ci yod/ rang gi sems kyis byas pa ma gtogs don la grub pa med pa sems kyis thag bcad/ yang de dag skad cig gis bdud dang srin por gyur nas/ rang nyid la mi snyan pa sna tshogs brjod cing rdeg btsog sna tshogs byas par bsams la/ mi dga' ba'i blo skye 'am mi skye lta| skye na de la mi dga' ba skye rgyu ci yod/ rang gi sems kyi byas pa ma gtogs don la grub pa med pa sems kyis thag bcad/ 'og klu'i srid pa ni/ yang rang nyid klu yul du klu'i rgyal por gyur nas/ de la klu'i bu dang bu mo mang pos g.yas nas mchod pa la sogs pa dpag tu med pa byas par bsams la/ de la dga' ba skye'am mi skye lta/ dga' ba skye na de la dga' ba skye rgyu ci yod/ rang gi sems kyis byas ba ma gtogs don la grub pa med pa sems kyis thag bcad/

yang de dag skad cig gis bdud dang srin por gyur nas/ rang nyid la mi snyan pa sna tshogs| brjod cing rdeg btsog sna tshogs byas par bsams la/ mi dga' ba'i blo skye 'am mi skye lta/ skye na de la mi dga' ba skye rgyu ci yod/ rang gi sems kyis byas pa ma gtogs don la grub pa med pa sems kyis thag bcad/ de nas rang nyid la dngos su gzhan gyis bstod pa dang bsnyen bkur la sogs pa byas pa la dga' ba'i blo skye'am mi skye lta/ dga' ba'i blo skye na de la dga' ba'i blo skye rgyu ci yod/ med bzhin du snang ba/ don la grub pa med pa yin mod snyam du sems kyis thag bcad/ yang rang nyid la gzhan gyis dngos su mi snyan pa sna tshogs brjod cing rdeg gtsog sna tshogs byed pa dang*/ 'phrog 'jom la sogs byas pa la mi dga' ba'i blo skye 'am mi skye lta/ mi dga' ba'i blo skye na de la mi dga' ba'i blo skye rgyu ci yod/ med bzhin du snang ba| don la grub pa med pa rmi lam sgyu ma lta bu yin mod snyam du sems kyis thag bcad/ mdor na 'jig rten chos brgyad mgo snyoms te nyams su blang bar bya ba yin no/ des dngos gzhi stong nyid kyi zlog sgom gyis bdag 'dzin rtsad bcad pa de song nas// gsum pa rjes snying rje'i zlog sgom gyis lha 'dre gdul byar sdud pa de ston par byed de/ de la zhal gdams dang*/ snying rje'i zlog sgom gnyis las/ dang po zhal gdams la/ lhongs tshad/ tshar tshad/ rjes 'dzin/ lhongs tshad 'dra ba'i tshar tshad/ tshar tshad 'dra ba'i lhongs tshad/ gnyis ka 'dra ba'i bag chags dang drug yod pa las/ dang po lhongs tshad la dngos su lhongs pa dang*/ nyams snang du lhongs pa dang*/ rmi lam du lhongs pa gsum las/ dang po dngos su lhongs pa la/ lus thog tu lhongs pa dang*/ sems thog tu lhongs pa gnyis las/ dang po lus thog tu dngos su lhongs pa ni/ gsang spyod la phyin pa na/ gsang spyod kyi gnas der lha 'dres gzugs dngos su ston pa dang*/

gzugs med pa'i lag pa rkyong ba dang*/ lha 'dre'i dmag gis bskor ba dang*/ bshugs skad 'tsher ba dang*/ lus spu zing byed pa dang*| lus la blo bur du na tsha drag po byung ba sogs lus thog tu lhongs pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'byung ba yin no// gnyis pa sems thog tu dngos su lhongs pa ni/ sems la bying rgod rmugs gsum gyi skyon dang*/ gnod pa dang*/ sems mi dga' ba dang*/ bla ma la log lta skye ba dang*/ dge sbyor byed snying mi 'dod pa la sogs mang du byung ba yin no// gnyis pa nyams snang du lhongs pa ni/ nyams snang du de dag 'byung ba yin no// gsum pa rmi lam du lhongs pa ni/ rmi lam du gong du shar ba de dag 'byung ba yin no// gnyis pa tshar tshad ni/ gsang spyod byed pa'i gnas de'i lha 'dres gtsos pa'i lha 'dre thams cad kyis phyag 'tshal ba dang*/ gus pa dang*/ dad pa dang*/ longs spyod la sogs pa'i mthun rkyen sgrub pa dang*/ de dag gi shugs kyis mi rnams kyis kyang de ltar byed pa 'byung ba yin no// gsum pa rjes 'dzin ni 'og tu 'byung ngo*// bzhi pa lhong tshad 'dra ba'i tshar tshad ni/ gsang spyod la phyin pa na lus la na tsha drag po la sogs pa byung ba dang*/ de la dmigs nas dge sbyor byas pa na/ sbar bas dge spyor 'phel zhing bogs thon pa 'byung ba yin pas na/ lhongs tshad 'dra ba'i tshar tshad yin te/ rnam pa lus la na tsha byung bas lhongs tshad 'dra'ang*/ de la dmigs nas dge sbyor 'phel zhing bogs thon pa 'byung bas ngo bo tshar tshad yin no// lnga pa tshar tshad 'dra ba'i lhongs tshad ni/ gsang spyod kyi sar bdud kyi cho 'phrul gyis bla ma dang yi dam gyi gzugs su byas nas lung ston pa la sogs pa 'byung ba ni/ tshar tshad 'dra ba'i lhongs tshad yin te/ bla ma dang yi dam gyis lung ston pa ni tshar tshad 'dra'ang*/ bdud kyi cho 'phrul gyis bla ma dang yi dam gyi gzugs su byas nas lung ston pa la sogs pa ni/

lhongs tshad yin pas na/ 'dra ba ni tshar tshad 'dra ste/ lhongs tshad yin no| /drug pa gnyis ka 'dra ba'i bag chags ni/ nyin mo za ma ster mkhan byung ba dang*/ nyin mo gzhan dang 'khrug pa byas pa la sogs pa rnams mtshan mo rmi lam du 'byung ba rnams dang*/ mtshan mo rmi lam du de ltar byung ba rnams ni lhongs tshad dang tshar tshad gnyis ka ma yin te/ gnyis ka 'dra ba'i bag chags yin no// zhal gdams song nas| gnyis pa rjes snying rje'i zlog sgom de ston par byed de/ de la spros bcas/ spros med/ shin tu spros med kyi spyod pa dang gsum las/ dang po spros bcas de ston par byed de| de'ang rmi lam du gsang spyod byed pa'i gnas de'i gzhi bdag gis gtsos pa'i lha 'dre rnams yul thon 'gro ba dang*/ ngu gcom chen po la sogs pa byung na/ rang nyid thugs rje chen po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ sku stod kyis gzugs khams yan chad khyab pa/ sku smad kyis 'dod khams man chad khyab pa/ zhi zhing 'dzum pa dang ldan pa/ mthong ba tsam gyis lha 'dre de dag gi bsam ngan gdug rtsub thams cad zhi bar nus pa gcig tu bsam nas/ de'i phyag gi mthil nas bdud rtsi 'o ma lta bu'i rgyun babs pas/ lha 'dre de dag gis khrus byas pas/ lha 'dre de dag gi lus kyi na tsha sems kyi sdug bsngal bsam ngan gdug rtsub thams cad zhi nas/ lus sems bde ba phun sum tshogs pas khyab par bsam pa'o// des spros bcas de song nas// gnyis pa spros med de ston par byed de/ de yang byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems sgom par byed pa yin pas na/ de la gsang spyod byed pa'i gnas de'i gzhi bdag des gtsos pa'i snang srid kyi lha 'dre thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan na snyam pa'i blo bcos ma ma yin pa sgom par byed pa ni byams pa sgom pa'o// de dag sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu dang bral na snyam pa'i blo bcos ma ma yin pa sgom par byed pa ni snying rje sgom pa'o// de dag thams cad bla na med pa rdzogs pa'i byang chub thob par bya zhing*/

de'i ched du bdag gis gsang ba'i spyod pa mthar phyin pa spyad par bya'o snyam pa'i blo bcos ma ma yin pa sgom par byed pa ni byang chub kyi sems sgom pa'o// des spros med de song nas/ gsum pa shin tu spros med de ston par byed de/ de ni lha 'dre dang rang nyid gnyis ka mi dmigs shing*/ mdor na chos thams cad mi dmigs pa nyid de chos kyi sku'i ngang la mnyam par 'jog pa'o// de las langs nas/ rjes thob tu sems can thams cad kyi don du bsngo ba smon lam rnam par dag pa 'debs par byed pa yin no// nā ro gsang spyod kyi dmigs rim 'di nyid/ shākya'i dge slong mi pham pad+ma dkar pos sbyar ba'o//
